docs.text: I researched birds on the Lake Erie Islands, right at the US/Canada border. The Canadian Coast Guard would chat with me (US citizen, researcher) all the time, curious about my work or just eager for some socialization on the lake. I can't imagine having to fear the Coast Guard while using the lake

for folks who might not know, the US & Canadian Coast Guards basically act as one fleet when it comes to Great Lakes icebreaking operations. this kind of collaboration is ubiquitous and traffic wouldn't move on the lakes without it
